title: SRE Weekly Update - 2026-09-19
summary: Weekly status for SRE: incident recap, SLO health, on-call rotations, and action items for reliability work
incidents: 2026-09-14 03:12 UTC - Partial degraded latency for hosted-api (payment route). Impact: increased 95p latency to ~2.1s for 18 minutes. Root cause: autoscaler mis-specified GPU instance type after a recent capacity config change; pods failed to spin up quickly leading to queueing. Mitigation: manual scale-up and rollback of config. Postmortem ticket: INC-2026-09-14.

2026-09-16 17:40 UTC - Short outage of metrics ingestion pipeline for 7 minutes. Impact: delayed dashboard updates, no customer-visible outage. Root cause: transient Elasticsearch node OOM after compaction job. Mitigation: restarted affected node and temporarily increased JVM heap; scheduled compaction throttling.

2026-09-18 11:05 UTC - Elevated error rate on Dedicated control-plane (auth checks). Impact: new Dedicated users receiving 401 for ~12 minutes. Root cause: bug in token cache invalidation introduced in release 2026.09.18. Rollback applied to restore normal behavior. Follow-up: backfill missing telemetry for affected calls.
slo_health: Overall SLOs: currently green for availability (99.98% last 7 days). Latency SLOs: payment-route 95p breached briefly during 9/14 incident but recovered; 30-day rolling still within threshold. Error-rate SLOs saw a small blip for Dedicated control-plane on 9/18 and are being monitored.
oncall_handoffs: This week on-call rotation: Week of 9/12-9/18: Primary on-call - Priya Singh, Secondary - Miguel Torres. Next rotation (9/19-9/25): Primary - Liam O'Connor, Secondary - Sofia Alvarez. Handoff notes: Priya has documented the outstanding follow-ups in INC-2026-09-14 and granted temporary team access to Liam for escalations. Zoom handoff recording: /shared/recordings/sre-handoff-2026-09-19.mp4
action_items: Fix autoscaler config validation: add unit tests and a pre-deploy lint rule to prevent instance-type regressions (owner: Riley, due: 2026-09-26).
Throttle Elasticsearch compaction jobs and add early-warning alerts for JVM heap pressure (owner: Sofia, due: 2026-09-24).
Backfill telemetry for Dedicated auth failures and add an extra distributed trace span near token-cache operations (owner: Liam, due: 2026-09-30).
Run tabletop incident exercise focused on autoscaling and capacity rollback (owner: Priya, due: 2026-10-07).
Document recommended deploy checklist for infra config changes including a canary step for autoscaler parameters (owner: Platform Eng, due: 2026-09-28).
work_completed: Rolled back problematic deploy on 9/18, applied hotfix for token cache invalidation, updated autoscaler runbook with emergency rollback steps, and tightened alert thresholds for queue depth on API frontends.
upcoming_maintenance: Planned maintenance window: 2026-09-22 01:00-03:00 UTC for Redis cluster minor version upgrade (expected: no customer-visible downtime, will perform read-only canaries). Post-maintenance smoke tests and runbook will be posted to the maintenance ticket.
risk_and_issues: Capacity planning: Dedicated region us-west-2 shows trailing utilization growth of ~12% month-over-month; recommendation to provision burst buffer for next quarterly traffic spike. Observability gaps: lack of end-to-end traces for payment-route retries - tracked in SRE-4823.
notes_and_links: Full postmortem draft for 9/14 incident is in INC-2026-09-14 and awaiting review. SLO dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/slo. Pager history and incident timeline: https://oncall.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-09-14. Please add any additional follow-ups to the linked tickets.
